body.text:
Implements iPhone Duo (foldable / dual-panel) support (resolving #9).

### Changes
- **Orientation support** (`project.yml`, `Resources/Info.plist`): Added `UIInterfaceOrientationLandscapeLeft` and `UIInterfaceOrientationLandscapeRight` alongside `UIInterfaceOrientationPortrait` so the unfolded inner display (`951×669pt`) and landscape orientation are supported.
- **Hinge pose observation** (`Support/HingeObserver.swift`): Added `HingeObserver` and `HingeReaderView` using `UIHingeInteraction` (`iOS 27.1+`, guarded with `#available(iOS 27.1, *)`) to track `.closed`, `.partiallyOpen`, and `.fullyOpen` hinge states.
- **Adaptive layouts** (`ListeningView.swift`, `SignInView.swift`):
  - `ListeningView` switches to a two-column `insetGrouped` layout on wide/unfolded displays (`width >= 600`, `.regular` horizontal size class, or unfolded hinge posture), placing the listening control and `Just heard` on the left and `Heard recently` on the right, while preserving the single-column layout on the closed outer display (`466×678pt`).
  - `SignInView` constrains the form to `maxWidth: 560` centered on wide/unfolded displays so fields and buttons do not stretch edge-to-edge.
- **Active-scene OAuth anchor** (`Auth/OAuthBrowser.swift`): `presentationAnchor(for:)` prefers the `.foregroundActive` `UIWindowScene`'s key window.

### Verification
- `swift test` in `StamperCore/` — all 90 tests pass.
- Built and verified on the `iPhone Duo` simulator (`iOS 27.2`, `iPhone19,4`) across `closed` (`466×678pt`, `1398×2034 @3x`), `open` (`951×669pt`, `2853×2007 @3x`), and `half-open` (`132.5°`) poses:
  - Atmosphere OAuth sign-in (`chromextensiontest.bsky.social`) and callback redirect into `ListeningView`.
  - Microphone permission prompt and active listening state.
  - `Settings` sheet presentation and dismissal in unfolded mode.
